SDN.note: Document launches an interactive dashboard of indicators by state; it names no published yearbook, bulletin or report and does not say figures are drawn from records as a published edition.
Document states no link or exchange between the civil register and the ID system.
Document gives general digital transformation of the civil registry but no births or deaths digital registration in service, pilot or coverage.
Document says nothing on a number given at birth.
Document describes a statistics dashboard, not digital entry of events at local offices.
